channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Letter: Lt. Gov. Henderson refused to trade my constitutional rights for political expediency. I stand with her.
item.description: Letter: Thank you, Deidre Henderson. While eight other states quietly surrendered millions of voters’ driver’s license numbers and partial Social Security numbers to federal authorities, you chose to uphold your oath to the Constitution.

item.title: At a new Salt Lake City bakery, its owner is ‘obsessed with croissants’
item.description: Utah Eats: A baker opens All Purpose Bakehouse in Salt Lake City's Maven district, featuring croissants and other French pastries.

item.title: Bagley Cartoon: Jesus Take the Wheel
item.description: Check out Pat Bagley's latest cartoon: Jesus Take the Wheel

item.title: Trump announces intent to replace Kristi Noem with Oklahoma senator
item.description: Donald Trump fired his embattled homeland security secretary, Kristi Noem, on Thursday and announced plans to replace her with Sen. Markwayne Mullin of Oklahoma.

item.title: ‘I didn’t really understand what was going on’: Despite visa approval, Utah resident was detained by ICE after court hearing
item.description: ICE arrested a 21-year-old man after a court hearing in Utah. His next 11 days were "terrible."

item.title: Voices: Utah cities are making it harder for builders like me to create affordable housing
item.description: “When local policy restricts entry-level supply, it limits not just housing choices but wealth-building opportunities for the next generation,” writes Morgan Cox, the CEO of J Thomas Homes, in an op-ed.

item.title: Iowa man in custody after three women were killed in southern Utah
item.description: Three women were found dead in and around Torrey, in south-central Utah, the state's Department of Public Safety reported early Thursday morning. Law enforcement arrested a suspect after a three-state search.

item.title: One former Utah Jazz player ‘didn’t enjoy’ the team’s alleged tanking — and was happy to move on
item.description: Kyle Anderson may have been a casualty of the Utah Jazz bringing in Jaren Jackson Jr. at the trade deadline, but he isn’t too upset about it.

item.title: Stranded in Utah, a 22-year-old killed 3 women for money and cars, prosecutors allege
item.description: Investigators say Ivan Miller told them he hit an elk and smashed up his truck days ago in Loa. Prosecutors allege he killed three Wayne County women Wednesday and took money and cars from them.

item.title: Names of 3 women killed in Wayne County released
item.description: Officials have released the names of three women killed Wednesday in Wayne County, Utah.
